sentences.en: During mating season many animals exude strong fragrances.
sentences.zh: 在繁殖季节，许多动物会散发出强烈的芳香。

sentences.en: Today I passed a person on the street wearing a refreshing fragrance.
sentences.zh: 今天我在街上遇到了一个穿着清新香味的人。

sentences.en: In the house, there is a fragrance of pine needles and resin.
sentences.zh: 屋子里弥漫着松针和树脂的香气。

senses.zh: 芳香，芬芳,浓馥，香气,香水，常用于广告语
